wminc-desc: Nidaamka tijaabada wiki ee Wikimedia Incubator
wminc-prefinfo-language: Luuqadda is dhexgalkaaga ka madax bannaan wiki-gaaga tijaabada
wminc-prefinfo-code: Koodhka ISO 639 ee luqadda aad halkan ka shaqaynayso
wminc-prefinfo-project: Dooro mashruuca Wikimedia ee aad halkan ka shaqaynayso
wminc-prefinfo-error: Waxaad dooratay mashruuc u baahan koodh luuqadeed
wminc-error-move-unprefixed: Khalad: Bogga aad isku dayayso inaad u wareejiso [[{{MediaWiki:Wminc-error-help}}|ma laha horgale ama wuxuu leeyahay horgale khaldan]].
wminc-error-wronglangcode: Khalad: Boggan wuxuu ka kooban yahay [[{{MediaWiki:Wminc-error-help}}|koodh luuqadeed khaldan]] "$1".
wminc-error-unprefixed-suggest: Khalad: Boggan waa [[{{MediaWiki:Wminc-error-help}}|mid aan lahayn horgale]]! Waxaad bog ka abuuri kartaa [[:$1]].
wminc-error-wiki-exists: Wiki-gan hore ayuu u jiray. Waxaad boggan ka heli kartaa $1. Haddii wiki-ga dhawaan la abuuray, fadlan sug dhowr saacadood ama maalmo ilaa dhammaan waxyaabaha la soo dejiyo.
wminc-error-wiki-sister: Boggan wuxuu ka tirsan yahay mashruuc aan halkan lagu martigelin. Fadlan tag $1 si aad u hesho wiki-ga.
randombytest: Bog aan kala sooc lahayn oo ka socda wiki-ga tijaabada
randombytest-nopages: Wax bog ah kama jiraan wiki-gaaga tijaabada ah, qaybta magaceedu yahay: $1.
wminc-viewuserlang: Raadi luuqadda isticmaalaha iyo wiki-ga tijaabada
wminc-ip: "$1" waa cinwaan IP ama isticmaale ku meel gaar ah.
action-viewuserlang: Eeg luqadda isticmaalaha iyo wiki-ga tijaabada
right-viewuserlang: Eeg luuqadda isticmaalaha iyo wiki-ga tijaabada
wminc-listusers-testwiki: Waxaad eegaysaa isticmaaleyaasha u dejiyey wiki-gooda tijaabada $1.
wminc-search-nocreate-nopref: Waxaad raadisay "$1". Fadlan dejiso [[Special:Preferences|dooqyadaada wiki-ga tijaabada]] si aan kuugu sheegno bogga aad abuuri karto!
wminc-search-nocreate-suggest: Waxaad raadisay "$1". Waxaad bog ka abuuri kartaa wiki-gaaga [[$3]]!
wminc-searchwiki-noresults: Wax natiijo ah lama helin. Waxaad ku raadin kartaa summadaha luqadaha, magacyadooda afka hooyo, iyo magacyadooda ku qoran luuqadda isdhexgalkaaga ama Ingiriisiga.
wminc-searchwiki-multiplematches: Raadintaadu waxay u dhigantaa luqadahan soo socda:
wminc-fs-intro: Ku soo dhawoow saaxirka tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya ee {{SITENAME}}. Waxaa lagugu hagi doonaa habka bilaabista wiki cusub.
wminc-fs-signup-text:
Haddii aad hore u lahayd akoon isticmaale, fadlan [$1 gal]. Haddii aadan weli lahayn, fadlan [$2 samee akoon isticmaale].
Looma baahna, laakiin si weyn ayaa lagula talinayaa, waxayna qaadanaysaa oo keliya dhowr ilbiriqsi in la sameeyo.
wminc-fs-userpage-text: Hadda fadlan samee boggaaga isticmaale $1 oo ku qor xog aasaasi ah oo kugu saabsan. Waxaad sidoo kale ka arki kartaa xiriirkiisa dusha sare ee boggan.
wminc-fs-startwiki-text: Horgalaha wiki-gaaga waa $1. Waxaad bilaabi kartaa wiki-ga adigoo abuuraya Bogga Hore ee wiki-ga $2.
wminc-fs-startwiki-exists-text:
Horgalaha wiki-gaaga waa $1. Bogga Hore wuxuu ku yaal $2. Hadda waxaad la shaqayn kartaa dadka kale ee ku hadla luuqaddan si aad u dhisto bulsho!
Haddii aad rabto inaad abuurto bog, kaliya ku qor magaca sanduuqa raadinta ee kore, oo raac xiriirka aad arki doonto.
wminc-infopage-welcome: Ku soo dhawoow Wikimedia Incubator, oo ah mashruuc ay leedahay Wikimedia Foundation ([[{{MediaWiki:Aboutpage}}|Ku saabsan]])
wminc-infopage-option-startwiki:
Haddii aad rabto inaad bilowdo wiki-gan, fadlan raac
'''[$3 tallaabooyinkan]''' iyo [[{{MediaWiki:Wminc-manual-url}}|hagahayaga]].
wminc-infopage-option-startsister: Haddii aad rabto inaad bilowdo wiki-gan, waxaad aadi kartaa [$2 $1].
wminc-infopage-option-languages-existing: Waxaad raadin kartaa [//www.$1.org daabacaadaha luqadaha ee jira ee $1].
wminc-infopage-option-sisterprojects-exi: Waxaad raadin kartaa mashaariicda jira ee luuqaddan:
wminc-infopage-option-sisterprojects-oth: Waxaad raadin kartaa mashaariicda kale ee luuqaddan:
wminc-infopage-option-multilingual: Beddel ahaan, waxaad aadi kartaa wiki luuqado badan leh:
wminc-infopage-contribute: Haddii aad taqaanid luqaddan, waxaa lagugu dhiirrigelinayaa inaad wax ku biiriso!
wminc-infopage-status-open: Kani waa wiki furan oo ka tirsan Wikimedia Incubator.
wminc-infopage-status-imported: Wiki-ga Incubator-kan waxaa laga soo dejiyey $1 kadib markii la xiray.
wminc-infopage-status-closedsister: domain-kan hoosaadka waa la xiray. Tag $2 si aad wax ugu biiriso wiki-gan.
wminc-infopage-status-approved: Wiki-ga Incubator waxaa ansixiyey [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Language_committee|guddiga luqadda]] waxaana la abuuri doonaa dhawaan.
wminc-infopage-status-created: Mashruucan waxaa ansixiyey guddiga luqadda waxaana hadda laga heli karaa $1.
wminc-infopage-status-beforeincubator: Mashruucan waxaa la abuuray ka hor inta aan Wikimedia Incubator bilaaban, waxaana laga heli karaa $1.
